name: Death Of Saints The
overview: Scripture reveals that the death of saints is not to be met with sorrow as those without hope, because believers who die in Christ are described as 'asleep' and will be raised by God at Christ's return. The Lord will descend from heaven, and the dead in Christ will rise first, followed by the living being caught up together with them to be forever with the Lord. This blessed hope provides comfort and encouragement to believers as they anticipate a joyful resurrection and eternal presence with Christ.
